components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:55px; padding:0 23px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:12px; border:0; border-radius:13px; color:#fff; background:var(--orange,#ff6b3d); box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(225,72,34,.23); font:760 15px/1 var(--font-body,Afacad,sans-serif); text-decoration:none; transition:transform .25s ease,background .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width:18px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); background:var(--orange-dark,#dc4822); box-shadow:0 17px 35px rgba(225,72,34,.29); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange,#ff6b3d); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Operational Event
components.description: Compact proof of a stock, sale, invoice, or supplier event inside the spatial world.
components.html: Stock fictif1 224 → 1 248+24
components.css: .ds-event { min-width:205px; padding:12px 13px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; border:1px solid rgba(102,115,216,.15); border-radius:14px; color:var(--ink,#151a3e); background:rgba(255,255,255,.97); box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(41,49,105,.16),0 8px 24px rgba(41,49,105,.08); font-family:var(--font-body,Afacad,sans-serif); } .ds-event-icon { width:34px; height:34px; padding:8px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:9px; color:var(--indigo,#6673d8); background:var(--cloud-2,#e6eaff); } .ds-event-icon svg { width:18px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-event span:nth-child(2) { flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; } .ds-event small { color:var(--muted,#62698a); font-size:10px; } .ds-event b { font-size:12px; } .ds-event strong { padding:5px 8px; border-radius:7px; color:#16735c; background:#ddf8ef; font-size:10px; } .ds-event:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-event:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--orange,#ff6b3d); outline-offset:4px; }

components.css: .ds-product { width:420px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #d9ddf0; border-radius:16px; background:#fff; color:var(--ink,#151a3e); box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(35,43,96,.22),0 9px 22px rgba(35,43,96,.1); font-family:var(--font-body,Afacad,sans-serif); } .ds-product header { height:48px; padding:0 15px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; color:#fff; background:var(--navy,#18204e); font-size:10px; } .ds-product header>i { width:25px; height:25px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:7px; background:var(--orange,#ff6b3d); font-style:normal; font-weight:850; } .ds-product header small { margin-left:auto; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; color:#cbd1f7; font-size:8px; } .ds-product header em { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--mint,#37c5a0); } .ds-product-body { padding:21px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; } .ds-product-body>span { color:var(--muted,#62698a); font-size:8px; } .ds-product-body>strong { font:690 15px/1.2 var(--font-display,Sora,sans-serif); } .ds-metrics { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:9px; margin-top:17px; } .ds-metrics section { padding:12px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; border:1px solid #e5e7f1; border-radius:10px; } .ds-metrics small { color:var(--muted,#62698a); font-size:8px; } .ds-metrics b { margin:4px 0; font-size:14px; } .ds-metrics em { color:#238469; font-size:8px; font-style:normal; } .ds-product:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-product:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--orange,#ff6b3d); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Profile Selector Row
components.description: Large Sora métier row with an orange active affordance.
components.css: .ds-profile { width:100%; min-height:78px; padding:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; border:0; border-top:1px solid rgba(24,32,78,.14); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(24,32,78,.14); color:#8b91aa; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; text-align:left; font:650 clamp(19px,2vw,27px)/1.15 var(--font-display,Sora,sans-serif); transition:color .2s ease; } .ds-profile span { transition:transform .2s ease; } .ds-profile svg { width:21px; opacity:0; transform:translateX(-10px); fill:none; stroke:var(--orange,#ff6b3d); stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s; } .ds-profile:hover,.ds-profile.ds-active { color:var(--navy,#18204e); } .ds-profile:hover span,.ds-profile.ds-active span { transform:translateX(15px); } .ds-profile.ds-active svg { opacity:1; transform:translateX(0); } .ds-profile:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange,#ff6b3d); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-profile:active span { transform:translateX(10px); }

narrative.overview: Stock transforme le commerce en un monde 2.5D relié : boutique, fournisseur, cliente, marchandise, événements et application partagent le même espace indigo-pervenche. Les panneaux compacts servent de preuves opérationnelles, jamais de grille SaaS autonome.
keyCharacteristics: Transparent authored 2.5D commerce scenes in one shared palette.
Dense Sora display over clear Afacad body and operational copy.
Cloud and indigo grounds with orange action, mango attention, and mint confirmation.
Pinned desktop spatial story translated into a sticky four-state mobile story.
Every synthetic metric is explicitly labelled fictive or demonstration.

rules.name: The Orange Means Action Rule
rules.body: Orange signals action, active operation, or progress and does not become a decorative section fill.

rules.name: The Functional Accent Rule
rules.body: Mango attracts attention and mint confirms state; keep those roles stable.

rules.name: The Two-Layer Voice Rule
rules.body: Sora carries propositions and consequential titles; Afacad explains, guides, quantifies, and triggers action.

rules.name: The World Before Widgets Rule
rules.body: Establish one continuous world; use compact overlays as operational proof rather than as a standalone card grid.

rules.name: The Same Story, New Choreography Rule
rules.body: Preserve all four states and their order; change only from pinned desktop to sticky mobile choreography.

rules.name: The Operational Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevation belongs to objects, controls, and interfaces floating in the world, not to editorial sections.

dos: Do build new scenes as one coherent transparent 2.5D world.
Do use floating interfaces to prove a specific operation and its system effect.
Do preserve supplier, stock, sale, and overview order across screen sizes.
Do label every synthetic datum as fictive or demonstration.
Do keep Stock visibly qualified as a working name.
Do preserve the complete story with reduced motion enabled.
donts: Don't return to documentary photography or mix the archived photo world with the shipped 2.5D world.
Don't replace the spatial scene with a hero-dashboard or SaaS card grid.
Don't use orange as a large decorative fill or swap mango and mint roles.
Don't present demo metrics, customers, testimonials, prices, or companies as real.
Don't introduce decorative eyebrow copy; small labels must name place, state, operation, or data status.
